g.text: Société du Coton africain, puis Coton…
Société Alsacienne de la Côte d’Ivoire

svg.text: 35 firms in 15 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 326 firms, 1,201 interlocks, 16 components (largest 291). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 95 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
